Who we are

A team that comes to you, because home is where you heal best.

Royal Home Health Care, Inc. is a licensed, Medicare-certified home health agency based in Van Nuys. We believe great medical care shouldn't require a hospital stay. Our clinicians bring skilled nursing, rehabilitation therapy, personal care and medical supplies straight to your front door.

Every care plan is built around you — your diagnosis, your home, your family and your doctor's guidance. We stay in close contact with your physician so your recovery keeps moving forward.

  • Your doctor leads

    Every visit follows your physician's plan of care.

  • We come to you

    Nurses, therapists and aides at your door.

  • One connected team

    Nursing, therapy and supplies, coordinated.

What we offer

Hospital-level skill, delivered with a neighbor's warmth.

From IV therapy to stroke recovery, every service is ordered by your physician and coordinated by one team.

Skilled Nursing Services

Hands-on clinical care from registered nurses, performed in your home under your physician's orders.

  • Wound Care

    Assessment, cleaning and dressing of surgical, pressure, diabetic and other wounds — with teaching so healing continues between visits.

    Learn more

  • IV Therapy

    Physician-ordered IV antibiotics, hydration and other infusions given safely at home, with line care and close monitoring.

    Learn more

  • PleurX™ Catheter Drainage

    Scheduled drainage of indwelling pleural or abdominal catheters at home to ease breathlessness and abdominal pressure.

    Learn more

  • Catheter Care

    Urinary catheter insertion, changes and maintenance — including suprapubic catheters — handled with privacy and dignity at home.

    Learn more

  • Vitamin B12 Injections

    Physician-ordered vitamin B12 injections given at home for B12 deficiency and pernicious anemia, with monitoring and education.

    Learn more

  • Insulin & Diabetic (DM) Injections

    Insulin and other injectable diabetes medications given or supervised at home, with blood sugar checks and hands-on teaching.

    Learn more

Recovery & Condition Programs

Coordinated nursing, therapy and support built around a diagnosis, a surgery or a hospital stay.

  • Hospital Discharge Care

    A safe, well-coordinated move from hospital to home — medication review, follow-up and warning signs covered from the first visit.

    Learn more

  • Post-Surgical Recovery

    Nursing and rehab after joint replacement, heart, abdominal and other surgeries — incision care, pain control and getting you moving again.

    Learn more

  • Stroke Recovery

    Coordinated nursing and therapy to rebuild strength, speech and independence after a stroke — and to help manage the risk factors for another.

    Learn more

  • Diabetes Management

    Nurse-led diabetes teaching, blood sugar monitoring, foot and skin checks and medication support to help you stay in control at home.

    Learn more

  • Homebound & Bedbound Care

    Comprehensive skilled care for patients who can't easily leave home — or bed — including skin protection, repositioning and caregiver support.

    Learn more

  • Cardiac Care

    Heart failure and post-heart-surgery care at home — daily weights, symptom tracking, medication management and education.

    Learn more

  • Fall Risk & Mobility

    Fall-risk assessments, home safety evaluations and strength and balance therapy to help you move confidently and stay independent.

    Learn more

    Tell us about the diagnosis or hospital stay. A registered nurse will help you sort out next steps.

Medicare-Certified Home Health Agency

$0 for covered home health services with Medicare.

As a Medicare-certified agency, we meet federal health and safety standards. If you qualify, Medicare pays for covered home health services in full. You may qualify if:

  • You need part-time or intermittent skilled nursing or therapy
  • You are homebound — leaving home takes a considerable effort
  • A doctor or allowed practitioner has seen you and ordered home health care
  • Your care is provided by a Medicare-certified agency like Royal

Durable medical equipment is typically 20% of the Medicare-approved amount after the Part B deductible. We also work with Medi-Cal, some private insurance, workers' compensation, regional centers and private pay.

How Medicare home health works Check my eligibility

How it works

Getting started is easier than you think.

  1. 01

    Step 1: Referral

    Your physician, hospital or clinic sends a referral — or you or a family member call us and we coordinate with your doctor's office.

  2. 02

    Step 2: Nurse visit & assessment

    A registered nurse visits your home, gets to know your needs, and confirms that home health care is the right fit.

  3. 03

    Step 3: Your personal plan of care

    Together with your physician we design your plan: the right services, the right schedule and clear goals for your recovery.

  4. 04

    Step 4: Care that grows with you

    Your team visits regularly, teaches you and your family, keeps your doctor informed and adjusts the plan as you improve.

Who can refer?

You or a family member · A friend or neighbor · Your physician or nurse practitioner · A hospital, skilled nursing facility, clinic or social service agency

Why home health care

Recovery feels different in your own living room.

Many patients find recovery feels easier at home — surrounded by family, on their own schedule, with care that fits their real life.

  • Familiar surroundings

    Care happens among family and the things you love — and your family can take part.

  • Physician-directed

    Every service follows a plan of care developed with, and signed by, your physician.

  • A safer transition

    Home health is a bridge between the hospital and independent living.

  • Lower costs

    Care at home can support earlier hospital discharges and lower overall health care costs.

Questions, answered

What families ask us most.

See all FAQs

How do I know if I qualify?

Anyone under a physician's care who would benefit from care at home may qualify. For Medicare coverage, you must need part-time or intermittent skilled care, be homebound, and have a physician or allowed practitioner see you and order home health care. Call us and a registered nurse will help determine your eligibility.

See Medicare eligibility

What will I pay with Medicare?

If you're eligible, you pay nothing for covered home health services. For durable medical equipment such as a walker or hospital bed, you typically pay 20% of the Medicare-approved amount after you meet the Part B deductible.

What does “homebound” mean?

You're homebound if leaving home isn't recommended because of your condition, or you need help — such as a cane, walker, wheelchair, special transportation or another person — to leave, and leaving home takes a considerable and taxing effort. You can still leave home for medical care, religious services, adult day care and short, infrequent outings.

Do you provide 24-hour or live-in care?

No. Home health care is provided in scheduled, part-time visits. A registered nurse is on call by phone after office hours, on weekends and on holidays.

Who can refer me to Royal Home Health Care?

You can call us yourself. A family member, friend, your physician, a hospital, a skilled nursing facility, a clinic or a social service agency can also refer you. We contact your physician's office to obtain the orders we need.
